headline: Peru Stock Market Suffers Steepest Daily Fall in Five Years
summary: The Lima Stock Exchange experienced its worst single-day decline in five years, dragged down by global tech sector volatility on Wall Street and falling copper prices.
why: The Lima Stock Exchange (BVL) is Peru's main financial exchange, heavily weighted toward mining and financial equities.

impacts.name: S&P/BVL Peru Select Index
impacts.why: The Lima stock exchange suffered its largest one-day drop in five years.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Peruvian equities plunged due to falling copper commodity prices and spillover volatility from Wall Street tech stocks.
